info.title: Shipsy Website AI Endpoint
info.description:
This spec describes the public AI chat endpoint that powers the Iris assistant on shipsy.ai. It is not the Shipsy logistics platform API.

Shipsy's enterprise logistics API (TMS, WMS, AgentFleet, Route Optimization, Multi-Carrier Management) is private and available to customers and integration partners under a signed agreement. To enquire about API access, integration partnerships, or developer documentation for the logistics platform, contact us at https://www.shipsy.ai/contact-us or visit https://knowledge.shipsy.ai.

externalDocs.description: Shipsy Knowledge Base — product documentation for the logistics platform

post.description: The conversational AI assistant embedded on shipsy.ai. Answers questions about Shipsy's products, capabilities, customer outcomes, and logistics use cases. Grounded in Shipsy's knowledge base — does not answer general questions outside logistics and supply chain.

messages.description: Conversation history in standard chat format.

200.description: Successful response from the Iris assistant

400.description: Bad request — missing or malformed messages array

405.description: Method not allowed — only POST is accepted
